for c in tesseract pdftotext pdfinfo pdftoppm convert magick gs python python3 node perl; do printf "%s: " "$c"; command -v "$c" || echo MISSING; done; echo "---"; ls /usr/bin | head -50

cd /app/documents && for f in *.pdf; do echo "=========== $f ==========="; pdftotext -layout "$f" - 2>/dev/null; done
for f in *.jpg; do echo "=========== $f ==========="; tesseract "$f" - --psm 3 2>/dev/null; done

mkdir -p /app/invoices /app/other
cd /app/documents
# Move invoices
for f in 2lgKzDuI4E4g.jpg JOiylq2_7S18.jpg KrJiw0OZx7jf.jpg ivE2mt3HwvEO.jpg lxtL9XrYRsVG.jpg vvK89XK847m3.jpg w0i40MJP2Dzm.jpg T0r6Ou8zvqTA.pdf UsN9tVTKskms.pdf wIQEB5nR79b2.pdf; do
  [ -f "$f" ] && mv "$f" /app/invoices/
done
# Move other documents
for f in 6NVuAIhTV4KB.jpg F0oZMhSUm2dO.jpg QOoA_j33PD_E.jpg WqWMArQQlSMv.jpg GFAlpKoFg81H.pdf dvkRkFVFhHga.pdf dx0AWchV01ZJ.pdf; do
  [ -f "$f" ] && mv "$f" /app/other/
done
echo "DOCUMENTS:"; ls -A /app/documents/ | wc -l
echo "INVOICES:"; ls /app/invoices/
echo "OTHER:"; ls /app/other/

cat > /tmp/make_csv.py <<'EOF'
import csv
from decimal import Decimal

rows = [
    ("2lgKzDuI4E4g.jpg", "6558.00", "0.00"),
    ("JOiylq2_7S18.jpg", "6860.45", "623.68"),
    ("KrJiw0OZx7jf.jpg", "9963.00", "0.00"),
    ("ivE2mt3HwvEO.jpg", "819.06", "74.46"),
    ("lxtL9XrYRsVG.jpg", "797.91", "72.54"),
    ("vvK89XK847m3.jpg", "6204.19", "564.02"),
    ("w0i40MJP2Dzm.jpg", "44745.59", "4067.78"),
    ("T0r6Ou8zvqTA.pdf", "4031.00", "0.00"),
    ("UsN9tVTKskms.pdf", "896.00", "0.00"),
    ("wIQEB5nR79b2.pdf", "440.00", "0.00"),
]

total_t = sum(Decimal(r[1]) for r in rows)
total_v = sum(Decimal(r[2]) for r in rows)

with open("/app/invoices/summary.csv", "w", newline="") as f:
    w = csv.writer(f)
    w.writerow(["filename", "total_amount", "vat_amount"])
    for r in rows:
        w.writerow(r)
    w.writerow(["total", f"{total_t:.2f}", f"{total_v:.2f}"])

print("total_amount:", total_t, "vat_amount:", total_v)
EOF
python3 /tmp/make_csv.py && echo "---" && cat /app/invoices/summary.csv

echo "documents remaining: $(ls -A /app/documents | wc -l)"; echo "invoices: $(ls /app/invoices | wc -l) files (9 invoices + summary)"; echo "other: $(ls /app/other | wc -l) files"; python3 - <<'EOF'
import csv
from decimal import Decimal
rows=list(csv.DictReader(open('/app/invoices/summary.csv')))
body=[r for r in rows if r['filename']!='total']
tot=[r for r in rows if r['filename']=='total'][0]
assert sum(Decimal(r['total_amount']) for r in body)==Decimal(tot['total_amount'])
assert sum(Decimal(r['vat_amount']) for r in body)==Decimal(tot['vat_amount'])
print("CSV totals verified OK")
EOF
